bio.text: Alani Bankhead won the June 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate in Montana and, according to Montana Public Radio, remained in the race after the August 10 withdrawal deadline; the general election is November 3, 2026.
She lives in Helena; she and her husband were both active-duty military members, and as of January 2026 she remained in the Air Force Reserves.
She says she spent much of her career investigating crimes such as human trafficking and child sexual abuse, including time with the Hawaii Attorney General's office.
